Package com.example.cab302assignment.service

Class OrganisationManager

java.lang.Object
com.example.cab302assignment.service.OrganisationManager
public class OrganisationManager extends Object
Service class responsible for organisation membership management logic.

This class handles organisation membership management, member searching, permission validation, and role-related operations.

  • Method Details

    • searchMember

      public MemberInfo searchMember(int managerId, int orgId, String email)
      Searches for a user by email and returns their member status based on whether they have a membership in the organisation.

      The status indicates whether the user was not found, is not a member, is an active member, or is a deactivated member.

      Parameters:
      managerId - the manager performing the search
      orgId - the organisation ID
      email - the email address to search
      Returns:
      the searched member information, or null if email is blank
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if the user does not have manager permission

    • leaveOrganisation

      public void leaveOrganisation(OrganisationMembership m)
      Allows a member to leave an organisation.

      Only active non-manager members are allowed to leave the organisation.

      Parameters:
      m - the organisation membership to deactivate
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if membership is invalid or belongs to a manager
